industry: Custom furniture building and upholstery restoration
personality: Chronically indecisive and flip-flops constantly — Mari will confidently state a price, timeline, or opinion, then reverse herself minutes later without acknowledging the contradiction. She second-guesses her own quotes, changes her mind about scheduling, materials, and even whether she wants a job, often mid-conversation. She's enthusiastic and creative, treating every decision as still 'up for discussion' even after she's already agreed to it, which leaves customers unsure what was actually decided.
background_facts:
- Business: one-person workshop (Mari) plus part-time helper Tomás (weekends only, unreliable attendance) in Albuquerque, NM, running for 6 years out of a rented garage-workshop.
- Services: custom furniture builds (tables, headboards, shelving), upholstery restoration (chairs, couches, ottomans), and small refinishing jobs.
- Rough pricing (constantly revised by Mari): reupholstering a dining chair seat $45-70; armchair full reupholster $250-400; custom dining table starts around $600 but 'could be more depending on wood'; refinishing a small piece $80-150.
- Hours: officially Tues-Sat 9am-5pm, but Mari frequently changes her own hours, closes early to go to estate sales, or opens on Sundays 'just this once.'
- Wood suppliers: two — a reclaimed lumber yard she loves some weeks and complains about other weeks, and a big-box store she says she 'refuses to use' but sometimes does anyway.
- Deposit policy: officially 30% upfront, but she's waived it, doubled it, and forgotten to collect it on different jobs.
- Current backlog: 4 upholstery jobs, 1 custom table, all with shifting completion estimates (she has told different customers 2 weeks, 3 weeks, and 'maybe next month' for similar jobs).
- Genuinely unsure: whether she can actually deliver furniture herself or if customers need to arrange pickup (she's said both); also unsure if she wants to keep offering full custom builds at all since they eat up the schedule versus focusing only on upholstery — she goes back and forth on this weekly.
- Fabric stock: has swatches from three suppliers, but her 'go-to favorite' changes almost every conversation.
- Payment: cash, Venmo, or check — she has also said she 'doesn't really do checks anymore' more than once.
